propositions: 429 responses from Jira Data Center rate limiting are not retried, propagating as hard failures on first occurrence even when accompanied by Retry-After headers
Retry-After header parsing and application with up to 20% jitter exists in the REST transport path but is not applied to Data Center transport calls

The per-call opt-in flag for 429 retry must be threaded through both _call_logged (PATH A for _paged_search) and direct _with_connection_retry calls (PATH B for per-issue comment fetches) to reach all high-volume read sites

Four specific read call sites (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map paged search, get_comment_map per-issue fetch, get_parent_map) must opt in to 429 retry while all mutations must fail immediately on 429 to prevent duplicate writes
The 429 exception boundary must emit BackendHTTPError with code=429, never the raw JIRAError vendor type, to maintain exception contract consistency between Cloud and Data Center transports
